quality_slice_runs.result: Obligation coverage was emitted but its repair could not run because the shared evidence_revision budget was already exhausted. The final one-claim text also exposed a denial-qualifier contamination bug.

A separate obligation_revision counter caused two bounded authoring_obligation_repair decisions. Denial qualifiers were removed from the positive writer projection, but the old analyzer still produced only one unique feature claim.

Obligation repair routed through targeted intake and increased selected snippets from 35 to 37. The focus identified PrunePredictor.forward, GaussianModel.get_prune_input_f15, and GaussianModel.prune_points, yet the legacy code-fact/evidence compiler still emitted only the feature claim. This is the sentinel proof that EvidencePacketV3 and CodeFactV1 are the next required implementation, not more benchmark work or more generic loops.

cross_project_findings: Zero unsupported final claims demonstrates leakage control, not usable Method coverage.
Three sentinel projects are explicitly routed to targeted evidence repair by obligation coverage despite legacy retrieval coverage between 0.67 and 0.90.
RAP is the strongest proof that the bottleneck is upstream claim compilation rather than writer fluency.
Every real figure has zero edges, so figure work remains secondary until the prose claim contract is repaired.
